Selected engineering projects

Audio Tools

I build real-time audio software and instruments for composition and live performance.

C++ / JUCE / Real-time DSP

SPEKANA

A plugin that shows the spectrum of live audio and lets composers capture prominent frequencies as notes, review them on a staff, and export them as MIDI.

Read the SPEKANA case study → Source on GitHub ↗

RAVE / Max/MSP / Neural audio

Glitch Voice

A live voice effect that uses models trained on sustained and burst-like vocal sounds. A pressure-sensitive controller lets the performer move between the two textures by changing their grip.

Read the Glitch Voice case study →

Arduino / Max/MSP / Sensors

Field Poetry

A custom sound box that maps light, temperature, and humidity to filtering, event density, and delay. I built the Arduino circuit and programmed the Max patch.

Watch the Field Poetry demo →
